metadata.description: Claude Code mods worth keeping, collected in one marketplace.

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Colorful, themeable replies: tables, code, diagrams, charts and tool rows in 15 themes.

plugins.name: glowup
plugins.description: A live cockpit pane for changes, subagents and context, an activity band, shareable themes and a pixel pet.

plugins.name: agent-portrait
plugins.description: Animated pixel-art portrait above the prompt that reacts to thinking, talking, tools, failures and idle time.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Flightdeck: a live agent dashboard for Claude Code. Main model vitals, an on-call architect, every permission check, subagent cards and swimlanes, a turn receipt and a session log, all from real session events

plugins.name: pokemon
plugins.description: A pixel Pokémon that lives at the right edge of the band above the prompt

plugins.name: paste-view
plugins.description: See what you paste into Claude Code: image thumbnails and long-text previews above the prompt instead of bare [Image #1] and [Pasted text #2] tags

plugins.name: human-in-the-loop
plugins.description: Claude assigns you the tasks only you can do. They wait in a My tasks pane, counted under the prompt, until you answer or reject them, so nothing Claude needs from you gets lost in the chat.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Skins for Claude Code's transcript: themed tool rows, reply gutters and spinner words. /skin swaps them live.

plugins.name: desktop-statusline
plugins.description: Status band above the prompt in the Claude Desktop app's Code tab: folder, git branch and state, session age, prompt count and cost, a context meter, 5-hour and weekly plan usage limit meters with reset countdowns, last-turn model, duration and cache hit rate, idle time against the prompt-cache TTL, compactions, and running agents. Toasts at 80% and 95% of a usage limit. Draws only on the desktop surface, so a CLI statusLine is left alone.

plugins.name: glass
plugins.description: A desktop-app look for Claude Code's terminal: colored shell commands in prose, a Bottom line card, content-fit code cards, borderless tables, gutter marks beside paragraphs that need you, painted tool rows and a turn footer.

plugins.name: figures
plugins.description: Draw diagrams, LaTeX math, and tool-result images inline in kitty-graphics terminals

plugins.name: paneline
plugins.description: Claude Code mod (plugin) that adds a side pane with Activity, Files, Agents, Context and MCP tabs, a status line above the prompt, a restyled chat, Mermaid diagrams in the terminal, tables, and code and diff panels. Colours follow both /color and the /theme (dark, light and others).

plugins.name: agentpane
plugins.description: A side pane for Claude Code that lists the subagents a session runs, what each is doing and what it costs in tokens, with each one's conversation a click away.

plugins.name: statuspane
plugins.description: A floating status card above the Claude Code prompt — model, effort, context, 5h/week limits, cost, directory and branch, GitHub CI and deploys — with clickable settings and a progress-row API any script or mod can feed.

plugins.name: mdview
plugins.description: Click a .md path in the Claude Code conversation to read it rendered as markdown beside the session, pictures included, and point at any block to have Claude edit it.

plugins.name: deck
plugins.description: A cockpit for Claude Code: plan bars and subagent strips, context, usage limits with reset countdowns and burn rates, spend, the model route and a pet. Six bar styles, three collapsed looks. CLI and Desktop.

plugins.name: whats-agent-doing
plugins.description: A small box above the prompt that always says what the agent is doing right now (reading, thinking, writing, running a tool, waiting for you) and expands to show what it has done.

plugins.name: fynn-mods
plugins.description: Six mods for Claude Code: animated Clawd mascot, usage-limit and prompt-cache bars, a pre-send message checker, quick replies, a to-do queue and a cost ledger. Terminal and desktop app, English/German.

plugins.name: remcycle
plugins.description: Garbage collection for Claude Code's memory. A mod that rereads your sessions every day, keeps what you decided, and questions the notes that have gone stale.

plugins.name: archpane
plugins.description: Live architecture diagram in a side pane that Claude draws and edits while you talk

plugins.name: pinboard
plugins.description: Keeps open decisions, the task list and links Claude creates in a sidebar pane, updated through its own tool

plugins.name: ricky-pixel-mod
plugins.description: Ricky, a pixel-art cat companion for Claude Code: an animated night-sky pane with a task / subagent / activity / files board, a cat in the band above the prompt, and a purple-gold spinner

plugins.name: dopa-mode
plugins.description: DOPA MODE (DOPA is short for dopamine) for Claude Code: fireworks for everything you do and every milestone Claude reaches (finished turns, commits, pushes, pull requests, passing tests), context and plan-limit meters with warnings, trophies, a daily command card and a focus timer.

plugins.name: mod-store
plugins.description: An app store for Claude Code mods, inside Claude Code: /mods to browse, search and install 2,700 mods, or ask Claude to find one

plugins.name: glanceflow
plugins.description: GlanceFlow for Claude Code: a calm checklist above the prompt showing the plan, progress and when Claude needs you. Simple view for everyone, Details for engineers.

plugins.name: sessiondeck
plugins.description: Live session dashboard mod for Claude Code: context, cache, permissions, tool latency, and a chart band for up to a hundred agents.

plugins.name: claude-code-agent-monitor
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: a band above the prompt and a /monitor pane tracking inbox, running tools, dispatches and custom cards.

plugins.name: a2a-mod
plugins.description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code: Claude hands tasks to non-Claude worker agents over Agent2Agent and picks up their results.

plugins.name: repo-radar
plugins.description: A live map of your codebase for Claude Code that lights up where Claude is working, with a colour per subagent.

plugins.name: claude-devtools-mod
plugins.description: Claude DevTools: a debugger for Claude Code tool calls. Breakpoints, pause/step/reject, timeline, inspector and Error Lens failure diagnosis, as a Claude Code mod.

plugins.name: code-wrapped
plugins.description: Your Claude Code Wrapped: activity heatmap, coding personality and unlockable achievements, right in your terminal.

plugins.name: installguard
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: looks up every new package before Claude installs it, and holds made-up names, typosquats and days-old releases for your answer

plugins.name: glimt
plugins.description: A quiet side pane for Claude Code: what this session is doing, its plan, its agents, and every other session

plugins.name: claude-mods
plugins.description: KOZMOS — live, visual mods for Claude Code (CLI + desktop): bands above the prompt, sidebars, status ticker, companions, guards and sound.

plugins.name: codyssey
plugins.description: Turn every Claude Code session into a little adventure: generative music that follows the agent's mood, a pixel knight who battles a monster for every edit and command, and a transcript retold in game style.

plugins.name: claude-code-tint-mod
plugins.description: Claude Code mod (CC tint mod): color each window by its repository, ring the window you are in, number your threads, and tint the whole Claude desktop app. Light and dark mode.
